model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of video types across a dataset, segmented into 14 distinct categories, each represented by a differently colored slice with its corresponding percentage labeled. The largest segment, “People Blogs,” accounts for 17.2% and is colored orange. The second largest is “Entertainment” at 13.9% (purple), followed by “Howto Style” at 9.7% (green). “Education” comprises 8.7% (red), while “Sports” and “Science Technology” each represent 6.4% (pink and blue, respectively). “Gaming” and “Travel Events” both make up 4.6% (gray and yellow-green), and “Comedy” accounts for 5.6% (cyan). Smaller segments include “Film Animation” (4.6%, brown), “News Politics” (4.3%, light orange), “Pets Animals” (3.9%, dark green), “Autos Vehicles” (4.8%, red-brown), and “Music” (2.3%, lavender). The chart uses a standard circular layout with slices radiating from the center, and each slice is clearly labeled with its category name and percentage value, allowing for direct visual comparison of the relative proportions of each video type.
